where a.plan_id = #{planId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

mapper.select: select a.plan_id, a.plan_name, a.type, b.dict_note AS plan_type_name, a.plan_point_types, a.create_time, a.update_time from t_cruise_plan a LEFT JOIN t_dict_business b ON a.type = b.dict_code AND b.col_name = "plan_type" where 1 = 1 and a.plan_id = #{planId, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1

select a.plan_id, a.plan_name, a.type, a.plan_point_types, (select count(*) from t_cruise_plan_attr b where b.plan_id = a.plan_id) as total, a.create_time, a.update_time from t_cruise_plan a where 1 = 1 and a.plan_id = #{planId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.plan_name like concat('%',#{planName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and a.type = #{type, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.plan_point_types = #{planPointTypes, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.create_time = #{createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and a.update_time = #{updateTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} order by a.create_time desc

SELECT a.device_id, a.instance_id, a.device_mete_id, a.station_id, a.custom_id, a.station_name, a.cruise_id, a.cruise_name, b.device_name,k.dict_note AS custom_name, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(j.mete_name) AND ISNULL(d.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(f.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(j.mete_name) AND ISNULL(d.inspection_name) THEN f.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(j.mete_name) AND ISNULL(f.preset_name) THEN d.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(d.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(f.preset_name) THEN j.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(d.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT(j.mete_name,'/',f.preset_name) WHEN ISNULL(f.preset_name) THEN CONCAT(j.mete_name,'/',d.inspection_name) END) AS instance_name,e.robot_name, g.camera_name,h.camera_name AS inferad_name,i.dict_note AS cruise_type_name,a.identify_type FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_std_device b ON a.device_id = b.device_id AND a.custom_id = b.custom_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_attr c ON a.instance_id = c.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection d ON d.inspection_id = a.cruise_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_info e ON d.robot_id = e.robot_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset f ON a.cruise_id = f.preset_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_info g ON f.preset_id = g.camera_name AND g.camera_type = 205 LEFT JOIN t_camera_info h ON f.preset_id = h.camera_name AND h.camera_type = 206 LEFT JOIN t_dict_business i ON i.dict_code = a.cruise_type AND i.col_name = "cruise_type" LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete j ON j.device_mete_id = a.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business k ON k.dict_code = b.custom_id AND k.col_name = "custom_type" where 1 = 1 AND a.device_id IN
#{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT} GROUP BY a.instance_id ORDER BY a.device_id, a.custom_id
